title: Scripture and the Holy Spirit
definition: Scripture and the Holy Spirit belong together because the Spirit inspired the Word, illuminates it, and uses it to sanctify God's people.
summary: The Spirit gave Scripture and uses Scripture to form believers in truth.
christFocus: The Holy Spirit glorifies Christ through Scripture by revealing His truth and applying His work to believers.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Holy Spirit does not lead God's people away from Scripture. He inspired the Word and works through the Word. His ministry is not in competition with the Bible but joined to it.

The Spirit illuminates Scripture, convicts through Scripture, comforts through Scripture, and sanctifies through Scripture. He brings the truth of Christ to bear on the heart.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Some people separate the Spirit from the Word, chasing impressions without testing them by Scripture. This doctrine matters because it teaches believers to seek the Spirit's work through God's revealed truth.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Depend on the Holy Spirit every time you open Scripture. Test spiritual impressions by the Word, and ask the Spirit to make Christ known and obedience real.
